sources.title: ESGO-ESTRO-ESP guidelines for the management of patients with endometrial carcinoma: update 2025
sources.publisher: ESGO / ESTRO / ESP / The Lancet Oncology
sources.notes: Primary European anchor. The locally parsed PDF and supplementary appendix are stored under evidence/endometrium-2026-07-31.

sources.title: Supplementary appendix to the ESGO-ESTRO-ESP 2025 endometrial carcinoma guideline
sources.publisher: ESGO / ESTRO / ESP / The Lancet Oncology
sources.notes: Provides the detailed LVSI definition, risk-group rationale, pathology requirements and evidence discussion.

sources.title: Radiotherapy for endometrial cancer: 2025 update
sources.notes: Current French radiotherapy anchor. Full recommendation text requires institutional or licensed access before validating dose, volume or technique claims.

sources.title: French recommendations for clinical practice, Nice/Saint-Paul-de-Vence 2024-2025: management of advanced or relapsing endometrial cancer
sources.notes: French systemic-therapy anchor for advanced or recurrent disease. Do not derive detailed treatment sequences from the abstract alone.

sources.title: FIGO staging of endometrial cancer: 2023
sources.publisher: FIGO / International Journal of Gynecology & Obstetrics
sources.notes: Staging anchor. FIGO stage and ESGO prognostic risk group must be taught as related but distinct constructs.

sources.title: Endometrial cancer: ESMO Clinical Practice Guideline for diagnosis, treatment and follow-up
sources.notes: Useful baseline, but postoperative molecular risk and systemic-therapy sections require reconciliation with 2025-2026 guidance.

sources.title: Radiation Therapy for Endometrial Cancer: An American Society for Radiation Oncology Clinical Practice Guideline
sources.notes: US comparison source. Published in 2023 after online publication in 2022.

sources.title: Substantial lymph-vascular space invasion is a significant risk factor for recurrence in endometrial cancer: a pooled analysis of PORTEC 1 and 2 trials
sources.notes: Mechanistic and prognostic evidence anchor for substantial rather than merely present LVSI.

sources.title: Ten-year results of the PORTEC-2 trial for high-intermediate risk endometrial carcinoma
sources.notes: Supports VBT for the studied high-intermediate-risk population while identifying unfavorable factors associated with greater pelvic recurrence risk.

sources.title: Adjuvant pelvic radiation therapy versus vaginal brachytherapy plus paclitaxel and carboplatin in high-intermediate and high-risk early-stage endometrial cancer
sources.notes: VBT plus three cycles of chemotherapy did not improve recurrence-free or overall survival over pelvic RT and produced more nodal relapses.

sources.title: Molecular Classification Predicts Response to Radiotherapy in the Randomized PORTEC-1 and PORTEC-2 Trials
sources.notes: Post-hoc molecular analysis; predictive findings require cautious interpretation and should not be presented as a standalone treatment rule.

sources.title: Adjuvant chemoradiotherapy versus radiotherapy alone in women with high-risk endometrial cancer: PORTEC-3 10-year outcomes and molecular analysis
sources.notes: Long-term high-risk evidence. Molecular subgroup analyses are post-hoc and must be labeled as such.

sources.title: Molecular profile-based adjuvant treatment for women with high-intermediate risk endometrial cancer: PORTEC-4a
sources.notes: Recent randomized evidence for molecular-profile-directed adjuvant treatment. Educational content must distinguish the trial algorithm from universal guideline implementation.

sources.title: Pembrolizumab or placebo plus adjuvant chemotherapy with or without radiotherapy for newly diagnosed high-risk endometrial cancer: dMMR subgroup
sources.notes: Subgroup evidence in high-risk adjuvant disease. Do not generalize beyond the studied setting or present subgroup findings without uncertainty.

sources.title: NCCN Guidelines Insights: Uterine Neoplasms, Version 3.2025
sources.notes: US comparison only. Full NCCN recommendations must not be reproduced or inferred without licensed access.
